role: Development test of a CUDA-stream dependency correction; not production qualification or WCET evidence.
hypothesis: Binding caller-owned TensorRT to the cuPHY stream removes two host synchronizations and transient input allocations that appear inside the measured NeuralRx tail.
mechanism: GPU0 publishes raw IQ and starts conventional; GPU1 uses busy polling, P2P, and one ordered cuPHY/TensorRT stream through CRC.
decision_rule: Only 1000/1000 correct pair completions at 4.5 ms may open a disjoint-seed holdout; any late or incorrect request rejects this implementation.
